Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Apex MSA draft / kickoff

Hi Ben (and Kimberly),

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to move forward. I'm attaching our current MSA (Apex_MSA_Draft_v1.docx) and a short SOW placeholder. Procurement asked that we get a contract intake going this week so they can align budget windows. A few initial notes from our side: 

- Apex will need US-only data residency for logs and analytics (no EU processing).
- Our procurement team prefers Net-45 payment terms; finance may require a PO flow.
- We use a two-signer authority for revenues > $250k and need the signing path documented.

Can we do a quick kickoff tonight or tomorrow to confirm the party matrix, which template we should align to (your standard vs our draft), and initial redline ownership?

Attached: Apex_MSA_Draft_v1.docx, Apex_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW placeholder)

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Partnerships | ApexTools
olivia@apextools.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
P.S. procurement@apextools.com is on the thread for legal/PO timing questions.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@apextools.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Apex MSA draft / kickoff

Hi Olivia — great to hear and thanks for sending the draft.

We can run a concise intake and map divergences. Quick plan from our side: 

1) Contract template choice: we prefer to start from Redwood's standard MSA (to preserve SLAs/operational clauses) and incorporate Apex's commercial Exhibit B if needed. If you prefer to start from your draft, legal will ingest and track variances — either works, but starting from Redwood's template usually shortens back-and-forth.

2) Party matrix & signers: please confirm the legal entity (full legal name) to be on the MSA and the primary billing contact (name, email, phone).

3) Residency & PO: noted on US-only residency — legal will flag any cross-border processing items. On Net-45, finance will need to review; can you copy your procurement lead so we can surface PO vs invoice flow?

4) Timeline & ownership: contracting will do an initial marked-change pass (first-pass edits) and return with comments within 3 business days after kickoff. Jordan will own the redline review; Kimberly will manage intake coordination + evidence (SOC2, encryption, KMS).

Can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow at 11:00 PT? If that works I'll send a calendar invite and our intake checklist.

Thanks — I'll pull Redwood's standard MSA and share a link in the invite.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0133
